body.p:
You can customize or implement a floating toolbar for the visual editor in a specific framework. This is achieved by using one of two properties:
-oxy-floating-toolbar - Used to configure and display a floating toolbar in the visual editor based on the current editing context.
-oxy-block-floating-toolbar - Used to configure and display a floating toolbar attached to a particular block-level element.

section.title: -oxy-floating-toolbar
section.p:
Use this property to configure and display a floating toolbar in the visual editor based on the current editing context. It accepts a space-separated list of the following functions:
oxy_button
oxy_buttonGroup
oxy_combobox
oxy_label
section.note: The "|" value adds a separator between toolbar items.

The -oxy-floating-toolbar property must be used in conjunction with the -oxy-selected and -oxy-selection-inside pseudo-classes. The -oxy-selected pseudo-class is automatically set on an element that is fully selected and the -oxy-selection-inside pseudo-class is automatically set on an element that has a selection inside.
section.p: This results in a floating toolbar that contains bold, italic, and underline actions presented in the visual editor when text in a paragraph element is selected.

This results in a floating toolbar that contains a Platform: label and a drop-down menu used to change the value of the platform profiling attribute. This is presented in the visual editor when a paragraph element is fully selected.

This results in a floating toolbar that contains Edit Content Reference, Remove Content Reference, and Replace Reference with Content actions presented in the visual editor when an element with a conref or conkeyref attribute is fully selected.

section.title: -oxy-block-floating-toolbar
section.p:
The -oxy-block-floating-toolbar property is used to configure and display a floating toolbar attached specifically to a block-level element whenever the caret is positioned inside that particular element. It accepts a space-separated list of the following functions:
oxy_button
oxy_buttonGroup
oxy_combobox
oxy_label
section.note: The "|" text value can be used to add a separator between elements of the toolbar.
The -oxy-block-floating-toolbar property does not require the -oxy-selected and -oxy-selection-inside pseudo-classes. The toolbar is shown automatically when editing the matched block element.

b.u: Example: Block Floating Toolbar for a Table

section.p: This results in a persistent floating toolbar presented in the visual editor at block level with row, column, and table actions whenever editing inside a CALS table.
